notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the 2017 game: RAWG id 28152 (slug star-wars-battlefront-2, released 2017-11-17) and Steam app 1237950. The 2005 game is a separate RAWG entry (star-wars-battlefront-ii-2) and Steam app 6060 ("Classic, 2005"); neither was used. StrategyWiki has it as "Star Wars Battlefront II (2017)" (completion stage 0); only its "Table of Contents" subpage is written, and the Walkthrough, Achievements and trophies, Gameplay and Controls pages it links are not, so nothing was used. On starwars.fandom.com neither "Star Wars Battlefront II (2017)" nor "Star Wars Battlefront II (2017 video game)" exists, so Fandom is unverified. 20 of 43 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the campaign chapter. The last three in the Steam schema ("Project: Resurrection", "Ashes of the Empire", "Inferno") are listed apart from the others; RAWG has a separate entry named "Star Wars Battlefront II: Resurrection" (2017-12-15), so they may belong to that add-on, but the data does not confirm it. A few hidden ones ("X-wing vs. TIE Fighter", "Master of Deception", "Balance Point") may not be story steps.
